description: Shared golden vectors for the %gw-btc kelvin-9 formats (doc/opret-revision/01-spec-revision.md as amended by 04-decisions-addendum.md). Consumed by the Hoon desk (tests/lib/gw-btc-pass.hoon), Causeway web (TS), and Causeway desktop (Python) suites; all three must agree with this file byte-for-byte.
generator: Hoon reference values computed with `urbit eval` against zuse's secp tagged hash; independently reproduced in Python (hashlib) as H_tag(tag, msg) = sha256(sha256(tag) || sha256(tag) || msg). Both agreed on 2026-08-03.

conventions.tagged_hash: BIP-340: H_tag(tag, msg) = sha256(sha256(tag) || sha256(tag) || msg); tag is the ASCII tag string.
conventions.jam_bytes: A jammed noun enters a hash message as its minimal little-endian byte dump (the ordinary byte serialization of a jam).
conventions.hash_bytes: Hash outputs (blind, d, c) are exactly 32 bytes, big-endian byte strings.
conventions.dat: dat = (can 0 (mat %gw-btc) (mat 9) [256 d] ~): the +mat-encoded domain tag at bit 0, then the +mat-encoded kelvin, then exactly 256 bits of d. Trailing data is rejected.
conventions.blind: blind = H_tag('gw/spawn-blind', minimal little-endian byte dump of the seed)
conventions.state_commit: c = H_tag('gw/state-commit', jam_bytes(snapshot)); snapshot = [life rift key sponsor fief]
conventions.state_leaf: leaf version 0xc0; script = OP_RETURN PUSH2 'gw' PUSH32 c = 6a 02 67 77 20 || c (37 bytes); single-leaf tree, root = TapLeaf hash
conventions.publication_script: OP_RETURN PUSH3 'urb' PUSH1 kelvin <payload push> = 6a 03 75 72 62 01 09 ...; payload cap 512 bytes; PUSHDATA1 (0x4c) for payloads over 75 bytes
